wallets.name: RoEUDIW
wallets.description: Romania's national European Digital Identity Wallet (RoEUDIW), led by the Authority for the Digitalization of Romania (ADR) with implementation involving MEDAT, MAI, and STS. Romania has formally adopted Germany's open-source EUDI Wallet solution. The official roadmap schedules a RO Wallet test version, an interoperability test bed and a sandbox for 31 October 2026, a restricted beta for 22 December 2026, and the official v1 launch for 14 January 2027. These dates are planned milestones; the public test environment is not open yet. QTSP partners include certSIGN and Trans Sped.
